title: Discovery provider descriptor
description: What a provider says about itself. The capability fields are minimal and DESCRIPTIVE — they let DiscoveryManager schedule sensibly, and are deliberately not a control plane a provider could use to claim authority it does not have.

name.description: The stable config/provider type name, e.g. peer-cache, mdns, static-bootstrap, kademlia.

interface_version.description: The discovery contract version the provider implements — not the provider's own build version, which the runtime does not require.

config_version.description: Present only when a provider's config schema needs migration.

supports_hints.description: A provider that does not support a hint class must reject it explicitly rather than silently accept it — accepting quietly is how a provider would drift into owning connection policy.
